item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Ira's coil of insulated copper wire wound on an iron nail and joined to a cell. Steel paper clips cling to the nail tip.

Which claim about this arrangement is correct?

options.A: The current-carrying coil acts as a temporary magnet, and the iron nail makes it stronger.
options.B: The clips keep clinging after the current stops.
options.C: Putting the iron nail inside makes the electromagnet weaker.
options.D: The cold electromagnet cannot pick up clips until its nail heats up.
